targets.approach: Starting at the end of the Lizzie's Basin 4x4 track, walk around the west side of the beaver marsh and climb the rocky slope to the towers. The towers form a southern line, numbered upward from the lowest, and an eastern line. Adam's Bush is on the south face of the S3 tower and begins up vegetated ground toward the golden crack above.
targets.name: Adam's Bush

targets.approach: Starting at the end of the Lizzie's Basin 4x4 track, walk around the west side of the beaver marsh and climb the rocky slope to the towers. Fawn Arete is on the lowest tower of the southern line (S1): look for the broad rocky ledge on its south side, and the route begins at the east end of that ledge.
targets.descent_text: Walk off the back of the tower from the top.
targets.name: Fawn Arete

targets.approach: Starting at the end of the Lizzie's Basin 4x4 track, walk south into Weeks Creek Basin, toward the big wall closing off its southern end. The better upper band of the wall is reached by hiking the gully on either side. Damocles' Weekness takes the rightmost arete of the wall, next to the High Sirens ice flows.
targets.name: Damocles' Weekness
